title: Isolation and Quantification of MmuPV1 Virions from Papillomas
author: Aayushi Uberoi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j8scrwe

steps.title: Harvest and Homogenize Papilloma
steps.instruction: Excise the papilloma from the ear and homogenize it in DPBS.

substeps.instruction: Euthanize the animal by CO2 exposure per IACUC guidelines.
Excise the papilloma using a scalpel, avoiding surrounding non-papilloma epithelia.
Weigh the papilloma and place it in a 15ml round bottom falcon tube.
Keep the tube on ice during transportation.
Add 700µl DPBS for every 10mg of wart.
Homogenize for less than one minute and immediately transfer the suspension to a siliconized 1.5ml sterile eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Recover Homogenizer Debris
steps.instruction: Wash the homogenizer to recover any remaining tissue debris.

substeps.instruction: Add approximately 25ml DPBS to a 50ml falcon tube and wash the homogenizer.
Centrifuge the tube to collect the pellet and aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 42.5µl DPBS and combine it with the previous fraction.

steps.title: Digest and Extract Virus
steps.instruction: Treat the suspension with detergents and enzymes to release the virus.

substeps.instruction: Add 7.5µl of Triton-X-100 solution (1% Triton-X-100).
Add 2µl Benzonase endonuclease and incubate at 37°C for 20 minutes, inverting the tube every 5 minutes.
Add 2-3mg of Collagenase H, vortex the sample, and incubate at 4°C.
Adjust NaCl concentration to 0.8M by adding 127.5µl of 5M NaCl (assuming a 750µl suspension).
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 5000 x g.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh siliconized tube.

steps.title: Prepare and Load Optiprep Gradient
steps.instruction: Purify the crude virus extract using a three-step Optiprep gradient.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a three-step gradient (27%-33%-39%) in a 5ml centrifuge tube at least 2 hours before spinning.
Pipette 1.5ml of 27% optiprep solution into the tube.
Using a long bone-marrow biopsy needle, slowly dispense 1.5ml of 33% optiprep solution at the bottom.
Dispense 1.5ml of 39% optiprep solution at the bottom to complete the three steps.
Let the gradient stand at room temperature for 2-4 hours.
Balance the tubes using DPBS on a gram scale.
Gently layer the crude lysate on top of the gradient.
Spin at 16°C at 50,000 RPM for 3.5 hours using the SW-55 swinging bucket rotor.

steps.title: Collect Virus Fractions
steps.instruction: Extract the purified virus from the gradient in specific volume fractions.

substeps.instruction: Remove the 5ml tube with forceps and mount it on a clamp stand.
Use a 27-gauge needle to make a hole at the bottom of the tube, slightly off center.
Collect fractions drop-wise: fractions 1 and 2 at ~500µl, fractions 3-10 at 250µl each, and fractions 11-14 at 500µl each.
Remove 20µl aliquots from each fraction into separate eppendorf tubes for quantification.
Store fractions and aliquots at -80°C.

steps.title: Quantify Virus Concentration
steps.instruction: Determine viral genome equivalence via agarose gel electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Release viral DNA by adding 10µl virus lysis buffer (0.1% Proteinase K, 0.5% SDS, 25mM EDTA in ddH2O) to a 10µl virus aliquot.
Incubate at 56°C for 30 minutes.
Load the entire volume onto a 0.6% agarose gel in 1X TAE.
Run the gel with known DNA concentration standards in parallel and stain with SYBR green.
